attempted_claim: For the Benson-Solomon exotic fusion system Sol(5) on its Sylow 2-subgroup of Spin7(5)-type, the subgroup homology decomposition over the centric orbit category is cohomologically sharp: all higher limits lim^i (i>=1) of the mod-2 cohomology Mackey functor vanish, witnessed by exactness of the logged amalgam-centralizer cochain complex with Smith-normal-form certificates.
claim_type: cohomological sharpness vanishing lemma for exotic fusion orbit category
decisive_failure: originality: FAIL: headline Sol(5) sharpness is substantively already contained in HLL 2201.07160. HLL Thm 1.1 (punctured=>sharp, all i>=1,j>=0) combined with Thm 1.4/4.1 (F_Sol(q) has punctured group iff q=+/-3 mod 8, with F_Sol(q)~=F_Sol(3^{2^l})) directly entails sharpness for q=5 since 5=-3 mod 8 and l=0 (2-part of 24 is 8). DRAFT itself concedes this direct route (Remark: 'q=5 itself satisfies HLL criterion...with no transport needed'). Absence of string 'Sol(5)' in HLL title/abstract does not establish novelty; substantive theorem covers q=5 as member of infinite l=0 family. Iso-transport Sol(5)~=Sol(3) is therefore proof of the same object twice under different names, not a new case. Admission's premise that Sol(5) lacked punctured group / was first open case is factually wrong (confuses isomorphism type l>0 with parameter q=5); no prior gap existed. Result is mechanical instantiation (q=5) of published general theorem, not a new theorem. value: FAIL: even taken as correct, result is mere parameter substitution with no independent retrieval value. Future researcher needing Sol(5) sharpness cites HLL Thms 1.1+1.4 directly (q=+/-3 mod 8 family); a note restating it for q=5 adds no lemma, method, computation, or boundary extension. Transport lemma is textbook category equivalence; Bova four-term collapse is automatic given vanishing; SNF fragment is generic toy matrices, not Sol(5)-specific data. Does not satisfy narrow-exact-invariant exception because value was already known/mechanically implied by HLL general theorem, not unknown. The admitted target's value rested on false open-gap premise; with gap closed by HLL, no standalone value remains.
